failed_or_abandoned: astropy AltAz transform fails offline (leap-second auto-update TypeError, as P042 found); replaced by the analytic GMST horizon transform; astropy used only for the ephemeris and the Galactic<->ICRS rotation.

Plain rejection sampling of the truncated Maxwellian starved at delta >= 366 keV (114 of 400 000 lab velocities above v_min = 784 km/s) and would have crashed the later look-ups; replaced by importance sampling uniform in lab speed above v_min with weight f(u) v^2.

First full run crashed on a numpy broadcast in the perpendicular-basis helper; second run exceeded the 600 s tool limit only because of pipeline buffering (sed) and was stopped; rerun unbuffered with N_MC halved (400k -> 200k per case), 1500 signal / 1e5 null toys and a 1500-point Helm grid at the coordinator's request.
Decision-table note for fluorine rows printed a mass ratio instead of the years factor; corrected and the seeded script rerun (all other numbers identical).
The '200-270 keV, delta = 366 keV' observed-statistic row is MC-noisy (effective sample ~1e3); the full-window value is quoted.
